answer_text: IP Overlapping can be enabled only under these requirements: the account must not use Static Range Translation; one IP range must be smaller and fully contained within the other; all sockets in the account must be version 6.1 or higher; and each site must have a unique Native Range IP (no duplicates). To enable it, go to Resources > System Settings > IP Overlapping and choose Enable IP Overlapping between sites (then Save). The feature is permanent once enabled (you cannot disable it from the UI; contact Support to disable). The KB does not specify a default Cato system range.
